title: Integrating multi-omics data and machine learning to identify endocrine disrupting chemicals targeting key ccRCC-related genes.
summary: Multiomics analysis combines ML prognostic gene selection with database-derived EDC–gene links in ccRCC. The AI role is principally selection of a prognostic signature; chemical targeting links are computational/database associations, not demonstrated causal exposure effects.
ai_technology: TCGA/GEO expression data, CTD-derived EDC links, 101 ML combinations and 10-fold CV select a five-gene prognostic signature; qPCR on four genes in eight paired samples. EDC exposure causality was not tested.
